item.title: ‘Hoppers’ Pops With $46 Million At The Box Office As ‘The Bride’ Is Ready For A Divorce
item.description: The Pixar magic just might be back. After disappointing debuts for originals such as “Elio” and “Elemental,” Disney released the division’s latest animated wonder, “Hoppers,” to a fantastic $46 million at the U.S. box office. The zany comedy also took in another $22 million overseas for a stellar $88 million so far. This is the largest opening for an original animated movie since “Coco” in 2017.
